688:t_3:26.en:
$$シャア$$
「Driven by his own desires, he wished for chaos and tried to control the course of the world so the wars would never end.」

688:t_3:27.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Indeed. That is $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$ of the $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

688:t_3:28.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「But that is merely one of the elements that make up the person called 'me'.」

688:t_3:30.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are you trying to snow us with that silver tongue of yours?」

688:t_3:32.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Are you... 《$$エルガン#keyword$$》 $$ローディック$$?」

688:t_3:33.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Correct. But that, too, is merely one of the elements that make up 'me'.」

688:t_3:34.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「What I am now is an aggregate of every $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$ that exists in the various worlds.」

688:t_3:36.en:
$$勝平$$
「You mean old man Jay-Ay has a bunch of different versions of $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$ inside his body?!」

688:t_3:37.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「By the way, the name '$$ＡＧ$$' is short for 'All Gathered', you know.」

688:t_3:38.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「And their representative is me! $$ジエー・ベイベル$$, that's who, nya!」

688:t_3:39.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Kindly do not appoint yourself as our representative.」

688:t_3:40.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「But it's the truth! I'm the supreme authority in this personality, after all!」

688:t_3:41.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「You oughta thank me, nya! I pulled your consciousness up at the very moment you died!」

688:t_3:42.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I-I don't really understand the situation...」

688:t_3:43.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「You of all people should be able to tell what we sought, and why we made our consciousnesses one.」

688:t_3:44.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「To understand others, to accept them... and to advance into the future together...」

688:t_3:46.en:
$$アムロ$$
「And by artificial means, at that.」

688:t_3:47.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Exactly, nya! As expected of a successor & $$イノベイター$$ & $$ニュータイプ$$!」

688:t_3:48.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「...Let me explain in order.」

688:t_3:49.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Through the influence of $$黒の英知$$, we learned of the future of despair... the existence of the $$御使い$$... before we ever learned of the $$スフィア・リアクター$$.」

688:t_3:50.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「To avoid it, $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$ of various worlds took various measures.」

688:t_3:51.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「One of them was the $$時空震動弾$$, nya.」

688:t_3:53.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「That thing was built by some $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$ or other, to escape to another world and get away from the $$御使い$$, nya.」

688:t_3:54.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Not that it was flawless. Thanks to various defects, it ended up causing something like the $$大時空震動$$, nya.」

688:t_3:55.en:
$$オルソン$$
「For something imperfect, its impact was immeasurably great.」

688:t_3:56.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I cannot say anything about that...」

688:t_3:57.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Until the $$大時空震動$$, even we could not easily travel between parallel worlds, so there is much about each one's circumstances that remains unclear.」

688:t_3:58.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「By the way, the $$ＵＮ$$ of the $$ＵＣＷ$$ was also a grand experiment of mine, nya.」

688:t_3:60.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Thanks to $$黒の英知$$, I... sort of knew the truth needed for $$シンカ$$, nya.」

688:t_3:61.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「So I thought I'd build a collective intelligence and consciousness from everyone's knowledge in a virtual space, and observe the $$シンカ$$ arising from it, nya.」

688:t_3:62.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「It ended in failure, though.」

688:t_3:63.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't talk like it's somebody else's problem! Do you have any idea how badly we suffered because of that?!」

688:t_3:64.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I'll have you know, I wasn't playing around in the $$ＵＣＷ$$ to escape reality, you know.」

688:t_3:65.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Even the Chaos Series of that $$カイメラ$$ was part of a plan to overthrow the $$御使い$$, nya.」

688:t_3:67.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Your $$カオス・カペル$$, $$ツィーネ$$-chan, was to reproduce the power of the $$知りたがる山羊$$ $$スフィア$$ that $$アサキム$$ showed me...」

688:t_3:68.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「The $$カオス・レオー$$ of 《$$レーベン$$》, who was enduring a hatred of women inside, was for an experiment to steal the $$スフィア$$ of the $$ガンレオン$$...」

688:t_3:70.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「The $$カオス・アングイス$$ of 《$$シュラン$$》 was for an experiment to use the $$次元力$$ of Ophiuchus, which has power second only to the twelve zodiac constellations, nya.」

688:t_3:71.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「You used me... used the $$カイメラ$$... for that?」

688:t_3:72.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「It's misguided to be angry, $$ツィーネ$$-chan. We were simply gathered together, each with our own purposes, in that gloppy, gooey mess of a world, nya.」

688:t_3:73.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「It is out of chaos that people evolve! That's my personal belief, nya!」

688:t_3:74.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「You... how far are you willing to go...!」

688:t_3:75.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「In fact, the $$ＵＣＷ$$ was like a treasure chest, nya.」

688:t_3:76.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「And the greatest haul in it was all of you in $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$, you see.」

688:t_3:79.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Because you overcame the malice I set up and came to understand one another, nya.」

688:t_3:80.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「On top of that, you even showed me friendship beyond the stars and love beyond species. Honestly, I had to tip my hat to you.」

688:t_3:81.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「To top it off, the $$カオス・レムレース$$ I built was defeated, and I learned the hard way how powerful the $$スフィア$$ are, nya.」

688:t_3:82.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I had built the 'Heavenly Prison' system into it to seal away those $$御使い$$ guys, though, nya~.」

688:t_3:83.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So that is... the truth hidden behind the $$多元戦争$$...」

688:t_3:84.en:
$$シャア$$
「So $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$ wasn't running from the future of despair, he was storing up strength to fight it...」

688:t_3:85.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That doesn't mean I can forgive what this guy did...!」

688:t_3:86.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「By the way, the $$ジェミニオン$$ I had in mind was a redesign and compacting of the $$カオス・レムレース$$, made using the data I got from the Chaos Series, you know.」

688:t_3:87.en:
$n
「The truth about the $$ジェミニオン$$ is that it's a machine built by the man who threw the $$ＵＣＷ$$ into chaos...」

688:t_3:88.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see. So that's where 'Clockwork Devil' comes from.」

688:t_3:89.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So in the end, there never was an organization called the $$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$?」

688:t_3:91.en:
$n
「You...! So you were lying to us after all!」

688:t_3:92.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Oh, stop! Don't hurt my pretty face!」

688:t_3:94.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Don't shy away from me, $n~. We've fought side by side all the way to today, haven't we?」

688:t_3:95.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...$$エルガン・ローディック$$... Would you please move the story along?」

688:t_3:97.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Having been contacted by $$ジエー・ベイベル$$ of the $$ＵＣＷ$$, we each went searching for Spheres, and by good fortune obtained one of them.」

688:t_3:99.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Correct. I entrusted it to $$カルロス・アクシオン$$ Jr., who sought to destroy the world ruled by $$クロノ$$, but...」

688:t_3:100.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「In the end it passed to Dr. $$トライア$$, and came to be mounted on the machine of $$クロウ・ブルースト$$.」

688:t_3:101.en:
$$クロウ$$
「To think there was a story like that before my $$ブラスタ$$ was completed...」

688:t_3:102.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「But you know, at the same time we learned, nya. The $$スフィア・リアクター$$ is no simple matter, so it will never go the way we want.」

688:t_3:103.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Sure, Representative $$エルガン#pilot$$, but nobody is going to cooperate with someone like you!」

688:t_3:104.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「However, it is a fact that $$ジエー・ベイベル$$ holds the strongest power among all $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$.」

688:t_3:105.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「So I thought... how could I make the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ do exactly as I wished...」
